opportunities.title: APEX Awards

amount.raw: Applicants can apply for up to £200,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researchers with a strong track record and proven ability to lead collaborative work, holding a permanent or fixed-term position covering the award duration, based in a UK University or UK not-for-profit research organisation. Up to two co-applicants from a different Academy remit.
opportunities.summary: Academies Partnership in Supporting Excellence in Cross-disciplinary research (APEX), in partnership with the Royal Society, Royal Academy of Engineering and Leverhulme Trust, offering established researchers an opportunity to pursue genuine interdisciplinary and curiosity-driven research across science, engineering, social sciences and humanities, with awards held for up to 24 months.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any researcher based in the UK who meets the conditions of the call; open to all career stages. Successful recipients expected to have prior public engagement experience; previous recipients not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Public engagement programme supporting ambitious projects to engage the public with the humanities and social sciences, working in partnership with a GLAM organisation (gallery, archive, library, museum) or performing arts organisation. Awards held between 1 April 2027 and 31 December 2028.

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027

amount.raw: Symposium covers travel, accommodation, and visa costs; seed funding available for international collaborations

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers affiliated with research institutions in the UK or Germany, in the humanities and social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Research collaboration symposium on the theme 'Humans and Nature: More resilient towards the future', bringing together around fifteen early career researchers from the UK and fifteen from Germany to discuss key questions, encourage collaboration and networking, with seed funding available for international collaborations.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships

amount.raw: Three-year award; Academy funds 80 per cent of salary costs, directly allocated and indirect costs under FEC

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early-career researchers in humanities or social sciences based at an eligible UK university or research organisation. British citizens and EEA nationals eligible regardless of doctorate origin; anyone with a UK doctorate; or those with strong prior association with UK academic community. Viva completed between 1 April 2024 and 1 April 2027; not appointed to a permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: Three-year award for outstanding early-career researchers in the humanities or social sciences to pursue an independent research project towards completion of a significant piece of publishable research, strengthening experience of research and teaching in an academic environment.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established researchers in humanities and social sciences ordinarily resident in the UK, holding a current long-term appointment at a UK-based HEI or IRO continuing for the full duration of the award. Independent researchers without institutional affiliation not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Scheme to promote the acquisition and advancement of skills in relevant areas (quantitative skills, data science, digital humanities, languages) by UK-based researchers, supporting innovative research methods through skills development, collaboration or dissemination. Awards held for 6 to 12 months, commencing 1 March 2027.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027

amount.raw: Up to £300,000 over 2 years (80% FEC; total project value at 100% FEC up to £375,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Principal Investigator must be a researcher from the humanities and social sciences based at an eligible UK university or research institute holding an established role for the award duration, of postdoctoral or above status, spending at least 20% time on the award. Co-applicants based overseas required; collaboration across SHAPE/STEM disciplines required.
opportunities.summary: Supports projects led by UK-based humanities and social sciences researchers working with international partners on genuinely interdisciplinary projects ranging across SHAPE and STEM disciplines on the theme of Mobilities. Projects of 24 months, beginning March/April 2027.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27

amount.raw: Up to £150,000 for 12 months (with FEC at 80 per cent)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based early- and mid-career researchers from across the humanities and social sciences. Up to two one-year fellowships hosted in DGAP's offices in Berlin.
opportunities.summary: Provides opportunities for UK-based early- and mid-career researchers to develop skills, networks and careers in the creative, cultural, public, private and policy sectors, embedding award holders in the office of the German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) in Berlin, producing policy-relevant analysis for German decision-makers. Applications invited in areas including security/defence, Indo-European relations, technology and AI, and strategy-making in Europe.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs

amount.raw: Up to £4,000 (in exceptional circumstances, above £4,000 may be considered)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award-holders or applicants intending to apply for a British Academy award in the next six months who need support with additional needs (e.g. disability-related equipment, caring costs for research trips, assistance to make an application).
opportunities.summary: Funding to support additional needs that applicants and award-holders may require, in addition to the amount already requested for research expenses. Offers rolling deadline, reviewed monthly, to facilitate the best possible research and inclusivity.

opportunities.title: British Academy/Leverhulme Small Research Grants

amount.raw: Up to £10,000 (applications for less than £500 not considered)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Postdoctoral scholars (or equivalent) ordinarily resident in the United Kingdom, requiring approval of employing institution; independent scholars eligible. Co-applicants may be from anywhere in the world but the Principal Applicant must be ordinarily resident in the UK.
opportunities.summary: The Academy's most popular scheme, providing awards up to £10,000 and tenable for up to 24 months to cover costs of expenses arising from a defined research project. Funded as a public-private partnership including DSIT, Leverhulme Trust and Wellcome Trust. Independent scholar deadline is 28 October 2026.
